name: Romantic / minimal (soft kick, clap on 3, airy hats, 117 BPM)
notes: Minimal drums that leave room for a guitar/piano lead. 1-bar loop here (beat presets are 16 steps). The 16-bar version used with the Guitar_Melody_2 (Empire) D-minor sample: fl_write_drums(kick=[[1],[1,11]]*8, clap=[9], hat=[5,13], bars=16). Channel levels used: kick 0.45, clap 0.3, hats 0.25, snare 0.3 (set via fl_exec_python channels.setChannelVolume). Pairs with melodies/dm-soothing-piano. From convention, auditioned only by the owner.
